propositions: The ADR-promised byte-total backstop trigger for snapshot store eviction was never implemented; _gc_pass only reads free disk space and entry mtime, never consulting the incrementally-maintained byte_total counter.

materialize_tickets populates the store by bypassing cache.acquire and never calls add_bytes, leaving ~620 MiB tickets-<sha> entries completely unaccounted in the byte_total, causing the store to exceed its actual size cap when one is configured.

The snapshot store has only two functioning eviction triggers (free-space watermark and max-age cold-trim) when three are promised by ADR 0005, leaving stores on shared volumes unable to reclaim space based on their own size.

The incremental byte accounting obligation established in #57 was violated when materialize_tickets was introduced as a second populate path in #67, creating a discrepancy between the authoritative walk reconciled by startup_sweep and the reported byte_total.
